 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Kumar Uday Singh, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Md. Iftekhar Mahmood, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHA SARTHY  ORAL ORDER 2 19-05-2023 1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner prays for grant of regular bail in connection with Mahila P.S. Case no.60 of 2021.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in the F.I.R. registered under section 498A and other sections of the Indian Penal Code as also under sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
the allegations are general and omnibus in nature.
There is no injury report nor are the allegations substantiated.
The petitioner is in custody since 21.8.2022.

4. Heard learned A.P.P. for the State.
5.
Call for the legible photocopy of the case diary in connection with Mahila P.S. Case no.60 of 2021 from the Court Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.24555 of 2023(2) dt.19-05-2023 of learned S.D.J.M., Purnea.

7. During pendency of this application, the petitioner is directed to be enlarged on provisional bail in connection with Mahila P.S. Case no.60 of 2021 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/ (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned S.D.J.M.,
